    This workspace's distinctive payload is fourfold. First, it preserves the
    complete "Forensic Workspace Import Corpus v4" - the 2,776-line system
    prompt that governs the captured Custom GPT - including its eight-section
    ontology (Operating Authority / Core Ontology / Canon Governance /
    Forensic Reconstruction / Dialogic State Evolution / Transition &
    Continuity Contract / Output & Continuity Schema / Validation &
    Completion) and the corrected-baseline section that stabilizes the
    Maestro/Mosaic layer separation (Maestro = production machine; Mosaic =
    separate cognizant mirror). Second, it carries the v4.5.5-clean baseline
    repair list (ten REPAIRs with explicit dispositions) derived from a
    2026-05-17 diff report - a governance-grade transition plan from v4.5.2
    to a candidate v4.5.5-clean. Third, it holds a 23,826-line raw
    cross-platform corpus dump (Maestro v1.12.1 desktop-app shell plus
    ChatGPT and Gemini exports, thread names including "chimera", "car",
    "studio") that may be the closest-to-source material for the project.
    Fourth, it holds a reconstructed Lineage A/B version changelog anchored
    to EX01-EX73 exchange numbers, providing a clean reading-order over the
    chain dump while explicitly flagging numbering non-monotonicity.
  artifacts:

- "maestro-custom_gpt-create_window - full 2,776-line system prompt of the 'Maestro v5 Process Spine (copy)' Custom GPT, named internally 'Forensic Workspace Import Corpus v4'; Sections I-VIII plus the 2026-05-17 corrected-baseline section and the v4.5.5-clean ten-REPAIR list"

    to produce branch_authority_register.md before further merge or repair
    work.

  active_slipstreams: null  # same: no v3 protocol slipstream_record schema present here. Honestly absent.

      missing_f: true  # adoption declared but MoMoney_Maestro_OS_v4.5.5-clean.md was not produced; operator promotion is the open F-loop
      pending_since: "2026-05-17 corrected-baseline section within the create_window artifact"

- q: "(captured preview) 'this is a sequential executing end-to-end process. why did you stop'"

- "v4.5.2 vs v4.5.5-clean: v4.5.2 is still named the governing primary source in the Canon Enforcement Kit; v4.5.5-clean is candidate-rebase; promotion requires operator decision. The artifact explicitly marks this as not yet resolved."

    - claim: "Maestro/Mosaic layer separation: production machine vs cognizant-mirror substrate, where Mosaic preserves node-edge relationships, hidden substrate, story, provenance, and reviewability outside the production engine (create_window §3 and §6)"

      pre_filing_sensitive: true

- claim: "Metacontainer variable formatting: PascalCase/CamelCase single values; semicolon-separated distinct values; OR for alternatives; commas forbidden outside LYRICS BLOCK (create_window REPAIR-05)"
      pre_filing_sensitive: true

  worker_contract_evidence: >
    The Custom GPT system prompt defines functional production "Councils"
    with speech-act classifications (existing canon description / proposed
    change / clarification / correction / objection / rationale /
    implementation note / guardrail / process requirement / exploratory
    speculation / binding decision / unresolved issue / supersession
    signal) and assigns named council roles in the preview-window
    (Lyric_Architect, Vocal_Oracle, Sonic_Curator, MixMaster_Ghost,
    AI_Arranger.vx4, LyricForgeGPT, "The Reformed Architect", Chief
    System Architect / Techno-Auteur, DJ Mo Money, Visionary Chronicler).
    What is missing is a formal "worker contract" document naming each
    role's inputs / outputs / gates as machine-readable contract objects;
    that schema is implied by the SEG/G-Card structure but not emitted here.
  classifier_routing_rules_drafted: partial
  classifier_routing_evidence: >
    The canon-state vocabulary (Baseline / Emerging / Candidate / Accepted
    / Deprecated / Superseded / Experimental / Unresolved) functions as a
    classifier set. REPAIR-06 adds explicit routing tags (CANON_STATUS,
    BASELINE_SOURCE, PROMOTED_DELTAS, EXCLUDED_MATERIAL). The NULL_STATUS
    taxonomy (resolved / unresolved / defended_null / conflict /
    route_back_required) is a routing primitive. What is missing is a
    single classifier module that resolves arbitrary incoming artifacts
    against these tags; it would have to be assembled from the primitives
    present, not lifted whole.
  vig_sel_post_generation_pipeline_status: not_addressed
  vig_sel_evidence: >
    The terms VIG and SEL do not appear in any artifact in this workspace.
    Honestly absent. This workspace does not address the VIG/SEL
    post-generation pipeline.

handoff_to_synthesizing_claude:
  most_important_thing_to_carry_forward: >
    The Maestro/Mosaic layer separation, stated in the create_window's
    corrected-baseline section (§6 Layer Separation): Maestro is the
    production machine (Technical UST canonical; Creative UST / Show Summary
    / Suno-ready prompts as derived render surfaces; SEG and G-Card as
    gates; Councils as functional production roles); Mosaic is a separate
    cognizant mirror preserving node-edge relationships, hidden substrate,
    story, provenance, and reviewability. This is the structural decision
    that organizes everything else here. If a downstream synthesis flattens
    Maestro and Mosaic into one layer, it will re-introduce a class of
    defects (artifact_first_misread, hidden_substrate_erasure,
    deterministic_engine_memory_layer_confusion) that this workspace's
    stabilized canon was specifically constructed to prevent.
  warning_about_misreading_this_workspace: >
    Do not read the "Forensic Workspace Import Corpus v4" (the create_window
    file) as Maestro spec. It is workspace governance - the system prompt
    of a Custom GPT environment that processes Maestro artifacts. Maestro
    spec lives in the v4.5.2 monolithic prompt (referenced but not present
    in full in this workspace) and in the candidate v4.5.5-clean (also not
    present, only its ten REPAIRs are here). The Custom GPT shell is named
    "Maestro v5 Process Spine (copy)" but its loaded content is v4-era
    forensic governance plus v4.5.x spec material; the v5 name on the
    shell does not mean v5 canon has been emitted here. Also do not assume
    the corpus dump's "chimera" thread name is the same artifact as the
    synthesizer's Chimera-V2 forensic extraction - from inside this
    workspace that identification cannot be made.
  recommended_next_slice_from_this_workspace_perspective: >
    evidence-contract. This workspace's highest-leverage artifact is the
    v4.5.5-clean repair list: ten REPAIRs with explicit dispositions
    (direct patch / formatting normalization / promote to spec / governance
    guard / layer separation / convert result-language to process-language
    / baseline inheritance / lock gate), gated by G-CARD CONDITIONAL PASS
    and route_back_required. That is precisely the shape of an
    evidence-contract slice: a formal specification of what gets promoted
    from evidence to canon, what gets isolated as execution log, and what
    requires operator promotion. The validator-tactical slice already
    exists in the synthesizer; the classifier-routing slice would draw its
    routing tags from primitives here (canon states + NULL_STATUS +
    REPAIR-06 transition headers) but would be partly derivative. The
    evidence-contract slice is where this workspace's artifacts most
    directly compose into Day 2 work.
